image_description: A white minibus parked on a residential street next to a brick house. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, a destination display above the windshield, side windows along the passenger area, and standard van-sized wheels. A license plate is visible on the front bumper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a compact, boxy silhouette distinct from full-size buses, with sufficient height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is prominent, and multiple side windows are visible along the length of the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has significant height relative to its width, and the entrance door is clearly located at the front-mid section behind the driver's cabin.
The door structure is visible with tracks/seams consistent with a sliding mechanism typical for this vehicle class.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, consistent with van-based minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the viewing angle; only the front and side are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus is painted white with a yellow destination header, fitting the typical livery description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle body, appearing as standard commercial van wheels.
The window count and overall dimensions align with the capacity of a 4-10 passenger minibus.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The characters on the license plate are distorted and nonsensical ('B3...'), lacking the sharp definition of real alphanumeric characters, though not completely illegible as 'text'.
The text on the yellow LED-style display is blurred and indistinct, failing to render clear letters.
Slight softness and lack of fine mechanical detail in the grille and bumper assembly compared to the sharper body panels.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle taxonomy and distinguish it from similar classes like vans or full-size buses.
To rigorously evaluate the severity of the text artifacts observed on the plate and header.
To verify the structural integrity of the vehicle's geometry and its spatial separation from the background house and street.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts around complex parts like wheels and door seams.

focus_areas: Text legibility on license plate and destination board
Structural coherence of wheel wells and tires
Boundary sharpness between vehicle and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the license plate text; while it resembles a plate, the characters are likely AI-hallucinated gibberish. Verify if the geometric depth auditor detects any warping in the straight lines of the bus body or the background architecture.
